verdict.rationale: SerpApi documents a 'script builder' to quickly generate code snippets and provides code examples across playgrounds/languages (serpapi-gh-7), plus rich parameter docs (serpapi-docs series) and markdown/LLM-friendly docs endpoints (serpapi-probe-2), suggesting some interactive tooling. However, there's no evidence of a true interactive API reference (e.g., Swagger/OpenAPI-style 'try it now' console) — explicit probes for OpenAPI/Swagger specs all 404 (serpapi-probe-3), and no mention of an in-browser runnable playground beyond the script builder claim. missing for 10: evidence of an actual in-docs 'try it' console with live runnable requests, OpenAPI/Swagger-based reference, and independent confirmation of the script builder's interactivity.
